question:
Directions: Each item in this section has a sentence with three underlined parts labelled (a), (b) and (c). Read each sentence to find out whether there is any error in any underlined part. Indicate your response in the Answer Sheet against the corresponding letter, i.e., (a) or (b) or (c). If you find no error, your response should be indicated as (d). 

The most greatest gift of life is(A)/ not the ability to live long, but to(B)/ live well and make a difference.(C)/ No error(D)
solution:
The correct answer is "**A**" 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in **part 'A**' of the sentence because '**most greatest**' is used instead of '**greatest**'.
 
• The **sentence** is expressing that the greatest gift of life is not the ability to live long, but to live well and make a difference.
 
• '**Greatest**' is the **superlative** form of the **adjective 'great**' which means **superior in size, amount, intensity, quality or degree**, hence '**greatest**' should be used instead of 'most greatest'.
 
• Hence '**greatest**' must be used instead of '**most greatest**' to make the sentence correct.

Thus, ***option 1*** is the correct answer.

**Correct Sentence**__: ***The greatest gift of life is** not the ability to live long, but to live well and make a difference.*
